blocks.html:
Designt von Albrecht Graf von Goertz - entstanden von der so genannten
1. Serie zwischen 1956 und 1957 nur 78 Stück dieser eleganten Cabriolets in Handarbeit.
blocks.htmlEn:
Designed by Albrecht Graf von Goertz, just
78 of these elegant first-series cabriolets were built by hand between 1956 and 1957.

blocks.html:
V8 Motor aus Aluminium, 3,2 Liter Hubraum, 140PS Leistung, 190km/h Höchstgeschwindigkeit.

Hydraulische Fensterheber, hydraulisches Verdeck, Lenkradschaltung.
blocks.htmlEn:
Aluminium V8, 3.2 litres, 140 PS, top speed 190 km/h.

Hydraulic windows, hydraulic hood and column-mounted gearshift.

descriptionEn: Designed by Albrecht Graf von Goertz, just 78 of these elegant first-series cabriolets were built by hand between 1956 and 1957.
